newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade $64, steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade $64, steady - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate early Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady.
Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 5,600 slaughter steers and 8,300 heifers; Week to date 79,700 which includes 33,600 formulated cattle to be shipped this week. Confirmed - 13,900.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 63.00.

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00, pen North Plains 65.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 62.00-63.50. Pen Utility to Choice 2-4 1200 lbs including heiferettes 60.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
